question:
Select the letter-cluster from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

**AU, BO, CI, DE, ?**
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e900b3446442b92cceeddfa2a27da249dc816e424f2cd76ec5c20d8743c8c148.png] 

The logic followed here is:-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7e033e96044dbdf7ac38616a6209d0394c471a8fdcdb435c3a872f5a2a8e96e0.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"EA".**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__**The logic followed here is:

Steps:

 
• +1 is done in the first letter to obtain the next letter.
 
 
• A + 1 = B
 
• B + 1 = C
 
• C + 1 = D
 
• D + 1 = E
 
 
 
• Vowels: **A, E, I, O, U**
 
• Vowels opposite order: **U, O, I, E, A**
 
 
• Vowel are written in opposite order to obtain the second letter 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/98589cf5c91acd63993f6bdfa7fee97138f9bba37ceb280ea7473f4ee9e49568.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is** "EA".**
